title: Technical Analysis Complete
subtitle: Price, volume and structure, tested against real data — including where the evidence is weak.
what_you_learn: What technical analysis is and is not, and what the published evidence says about its edge
Candlesticks, support and resistance, trend and market structure, and how to read volume against price

Build a rules-based checklist, backtest it on history, and log 20 setups to compute win rate and expectancy
